working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 13B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any hemilineage B (Notch OFF) neuron that develops from neuroblast NB4-2 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis. In thoracic segments, these neurons tend to follow the commissural axons of their primary predecessors, then become local leg interneurons during metamorphosis (Truman et al., 2023).

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 13B (lineage markers and fast-acting neurotransmitter, Figure 4): its secondary (postembryonic) neurons.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00051470 hemilineage 13B secondary neuron (exact match).
